postActions.description: Generate dev RSA key pair for JWT signing.

manualInstructions.text: Run ./scripts/gen-test-rsa-pem.sh from the project root to generate the dev keypair. Windows users without WSL: install OpenSSL + bash, OR generate the keypair manually and place dev-priv.pem + dev-pub.pem under src/<YourName>/keys/.
